briefing_for_root_scientist: Round 4 delivered the run's decisive result: IYGV 4.3877 improves the best by +1.556 (2.05x final CV RMSE, clears the pre-committed >0.7 gap rule), found by EXPLOIT_MODEL's rank-4 pick (predicted 1.846) as a Hamming-2 double with strong positive epistasis; LOCAL_MUTATE's FNGA 3.2615 is a second raw improvement but within one RMSE of INGA. The run is fair and leakage-free (96/96, 24/round, 0 rejections, pre-committed rule applied). Mandatory qualifiers for any claim: (1) no replicate measurements exist — 4.3877/3.2615/2.8315 are single-shot; (2) IYGV parses as Y40+V54 under our own naming convention, not Y39+V54 as final prose said — resolve before downstream design; (3) new_point_prediction_rmse was never logged; (4) the surrogate is rank-useful but magnitude-unreliable on Hamming-2+ (residual +2.54).

final_run_summary: Run adaptive_omnigent_seed_000 completed 96/96 assays (4x24, 0 unavailable rejections) and improved the observed best from 2.8315 (INGA, R2) to 4.3877 (IYGV, R4), a +1.556 gap equal to ~2x the final CV RMSE that clears the pre-committed >0.7 acceptance rule; the hit came from the EXPLOIT_MODEL arm's 4th-ranked candidate (predicted 1.846), a Hamming-2 double showing strong positive epistasis (YxV +2.3/+2.5), while LOCAL_MUTATE supplied the best single (FNGA 3.2615, within noise of INGA). G41 essentiality was strengthened (L/K/F at pos41 all <=0.0303), H-01 (INGA peak) was falsified, and the zero-double-mutant blind spot was closed with sign-variable epistasis confirming singles-rank != combination-rank. The surrogate proved rank-useful but magnitude-blind (residual +2.54 on the key discovery; CV RMSE rose to 0.759), and the uncertainty/diversity arms returned ~0 as predicted. Defensible final claim: best observed fitness 4.3877 = IYGV (single replicate, identity parsing U-01: Y at pos40 per code convention vs pos39 per prose — positive-epistasis magnitude robust to the parse, partner position not); replication and a missing matrix cell are required before using 4.3877 for downstream design.

findings.evidence: Best improved 2.8315 -> 4.3877 (IYGV), gap +1.556 = 2.05x final CV RMSE (0.759) and 2.8x R3 CV RMSE (0.551). Pre-committed rule (gap > 0.7) HOLDS. But the replicate prong of the same rule was vacated by design: pools excluded measured sequences, so no replicate of IYGV (or INGA/INGV) exists; final best is a single-shot measurement.

Surrogate magnitude failure on the discovery itself: IYGV predicted 1.846 (rank 4), observed 4.3877 -> residual +2.54 (~3.3x final CV RMSE). Ranking worked, magnitudes did not. Final CV RMSE rose 0.551 (n=72) -> 0.759 (n=96). new_point_prediction_rmse still None (never logged).

U-01 identity ambiguity propagated: authoritative pre-committed convention (planner naming_note: letter1=pos39, letter2=pos40, letter3=pos41, letter4=pos54) parses IYGV as Y at POS40 (IYGA 2.4352 = Y40 single is the partner), while final prose says 'pos39 Y' (YNGA 2.6513). Positive-epistasis magnitude robust to the parse (+2.50 vs +2.28), partner position is not.

Parsing contamination in final hypothesis report (OBS-05): 'pos40 scan ... M 1.1402, I 0.0028, ~870x spread' — INMA = M at pos41 and INIA = I at pos41, NOT pos40. Corrected pos40 set (n=9): N 2.8315 > Y 2.4352 > K 2.0137 > V 1.9130 > L 0.7183 > E 0.6130 > P 0.5096 > G 0.1679 > W 0.0153.
FNGA 3.2615 (LOCAL_MUTATE) is a second raw improvement over 2.8315 but +0.43 < CV RMSE 0.759: not statistically resolvable vs INGA.

Sign-variable epistasis on the 39/40x54 axis: YxV +2.3/+2.5 (IYGV), FxV -1.65 (FNGV 1.0694 vs additive 2.72), KxV ~ -0.10 (IKGV 1.3680 vs 1.47), VxV +0.31 (IVGV 1.6780 vs 1.37). Singles-rank and combination-rank diverge sharply.

EXPLORE_UNCERTAIN (INKV 0.0044) and EXPLORE_DIVERSE (PYFV 0.0032) both ~floor in the final round; consistent with G41 essentiality (both carry pos41 substitutions) — cut 4->1 and 2->1 was correct ex post.
Pool collapse 23/24 near INGA/INGV family + 1 guard (PYFV): acceptable in a terminal round; global-coverage claims unsupported.
